---
description: "Use when writing or reviewing project documentation, requirements, architecture, decisions, task plans, or AI work records."
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md"
---
# Documentation Instructions

- Keep topic-specific documents in the structure shown in the project tree, including `docs/decisions/` and `docs/ai/`.
- Link to existing canonical records instead of maintaining duplicate copies under legacy filenames.
- When both a legacy root-level document and a structured document exist, preserve their content and link between them; do not silently rename or remove either.
- Distinguish confirmed requirements, approved decisions, proposed approaches, and open questions.
- Keep task scope and verification evidence factual. Never claim tests or commands passed unless they were run.
- Use concise Markdown and relative links; update only documents directly relevant to the active task.
